subject.title: [Feature]: Mobile apps: read-only workspace file browser (browse, preview, share)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow read-only agents.workspace list/read surface for mobile workspace browsing now, separate from the broader full-CRUD workspace API?
rationale: The product gap is clear, but arbitrary in-workspace file reads through Gateway and mobile apps change a security boundary and the issue is protected by the maintainer label.

options.title: Approve Read-Only Mobile Slice
options.body: Land a bounded read-only Gateway RPC pair plus iOS/Android browse, text/image preview, and share flows after security review, leaving write/delete/upload to the broader workspace-management thread.

options.title: Defer To Full Workspace API
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers settle the broader agents.workspace CRUD API and then implement mobile on top of that approved contract.

options.title: Keep Existing Boundaries
options.body: Preserve the current bootstrap-file and session-touched-file APIs and leave mobile users without arbitrary workspace browsing for now.

recommendation.title: Approve Read-Only Mobile Slice
recommendation.body: Land a bounded read-only Gateway RPC pair plus iOS/Android browse, text/image preview, and share flows after security review, leaving write/delete/upload to the broader workspace-management thread.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the protected request and authored the active stacked read-only Gateway/iOS/Android candidate PRs, making them the best available owner for the product/security choice.
